summary: Beta.5 keeps contactors stable while circuits restore and adds native Power Grid highlights to selectable CEE terminals. API 1.0.0 and existing saves stay compatible.
changes: Preserve contactor state while coil readings are unavailable; retain normal switching once solving resumes.
Show CEE terminal boxes and labels with PG wire tools or Engineer's Goggles. Tiny capacitor-pin targeting remains unresolved.
Separate headless and graphical acceptance, share artifact preparation and remove repeated client tours.
installation: Use Minecraft 1.21.1, NeoForge 21.1.231 or 21.1.248, Java 21, Create 6.0.10-280, CEE 1.1.3, Power Grid 0.6.2 and Architectury 13.0.8. Match server and client mod versions.
optional_installation: Pinout editions also require CC:Tweaked 1.120.2 and CC;CPG: Pinout 0.2.1.
